method_card.objective: Read the exact PDF revision that the indexed arXiv search returned.
method_card.mechanism: Supply candidates.json from arxiv-search@1 and parameter arxiv_id, including its vN revision. Download the exact versioned PDF through Clash and record its content hash.
method_card.estimator: article.pdf contains original PDF bytes. acquisition.json identifies the versioned endpoint, accession, retrieval time and exact bytes for gx_read_source page locations.
method_card.training_data_lineage: Public catalogue and original-source records; no trained model.

manifest.licence: GX release source. Original materials retain their respective licences.
manifest.licence_basis: Public arXiv metadata and preprints under their respective distribution licences.
manifest.limitations: Versioned PDF links from the selected search only, up to 32 MiB. Embedded-text page extraction can miss figures or reading order. Snapshot binding does not establish scientific validity or publication review.
